[[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] '''Monio''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual hailed from the [[Dentamma Nebula/Legends|Dentamma Nebula]] and owned the [[Unnipar system/Legends|Unnipar system]] until the [[Teltior]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Ceezva]] won it off him in a high-stakes [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game.
